subject: Support for Summer School: compute credits & onboarding
messages:
From: Dr. Leena Basu <leena@openedu.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: compute support for OpenEdu Summer School

Hi Camila,

I hope you’re well — I’m Leena, program director at OpenEdu Collective. We’re running a 6-week summer school (Aug 9–Sep 17) for 40 fellows working on small NLP and accessible-education projects. Each team will need short bursts of compute for model fine-tuning and inference (mostly short sequences, evaluation runs, and embeddings for retrieval).

Budget is limited; we’re soliciting sponsor support in the form of platform credits or a short-term trial extension to cover student projects. Rough estimate: ~150k tokens per team across the course (so roughly 6M tokens total), plus a handful of larger evaluation jobs.

Could Redwood provide a promotional credit or trial extension we can allocate to participant accounts? Happy to share the program outline and a one-page sponsor blurb — attached is a brief proposal.

Thanks for considering — we’d love to get something in place before July 26.

Best,
Dr. Leena Basu
Program Director, OpenEdu Collective
leena@openedu.org
attachments: program-outline.pdf (pdf)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Leena Basu <leena@openedu.org>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: compute support for OpenEdu Summer School

Hi Leena — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the clear summary. This sounds like a fantastic program. Quick answers and next steps: 

- We commonly provide promotional credits or short trial top-ups for vetted educational programs. Typical pilot credit for a single cohort is $2,500 equivalent; with the scale here we can discuss a larger grant.
- To propose an approved package I’ll need: 1) a point of contact for billing/account provisioning (institutional or program email), 2) an estimate of how you’d like credits split (per-team or central project account), and 3) any procurement restrictions (POs, invoice terms).

If you can share the preferred account email and a short usage estimate (per-team vs pooled) I’ll loop in our grants and onboarding teams to approve and issue the credits. We can also require a short sponsor acknowledgment line in your materials.

I’m looping this to our grants lead for approval once we have those details.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
phone: +1 415-555-0183
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Leena Basu <leena@openedu.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: compute support for OpenEdu Summer School — request for credits approval

Marissa / Dev — forwarding a request from OpenEdu Collective. Highlights: 40 participants over 6 weeks; approximate total usage ~6M tokens (mostly short runs + embeddings). Leena is flexible on allocation (per-team or pooled). They’re asking for a promotional credit or trial extension we can provision to student accounts.

Ask: 
- Marissa: can grants approve a $3,000 promo credit (one-off) for this cohort? They’d like confirmation before July 26. If approved, we’ll provide an agreement and expire credits after 90 days.
- Dev: can you prepare a short onboarding doc + a single shared project/account template we can hand to the program? Also confirm whether embedding-heavy workloads might require any special config (quantization suggestions etc.).

I’ve attached a draft sponsorship agreement and an invoice template they may use.

Thanks —
Camila
attachments: sponsorship_agreement_v1.pdf (pdf), invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Dr. Leena Basu <leena@openedu.org>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: compute support for OpenEdu Summer School — request for credits approval

Camila — thanks for the context. Approved: we can grant a $3,000 promotional credit for the cohort, with the following conditions: 

- Credits will be issued to a single program-managed account (OpenEdu to provide the account email).
- Credits expire 90 days after issuance.
- We require a countersigned sponsorship agreement and a billing contact for invoicing/record-keeping.

Leena — welcome! Please send the account email and a billing contact (name + email + PO if needed). Once we receive the signed agreement and billing contact we’ll issue the credits and provide setup instructions.

Marissa Cole
Grants & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Dr. Leena Basu <leena@openedu.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: compute support for OpenEdu Summer School — request for credits approval

Hi Marissa, Camila — wonderful, thank you. OpenEdu will accept the $3,000 credit and we prefer a pooled program account. Billing contact is:

Accounts Manager — OpenEdu Collective
accounts@openedu.org
PO: OE-2027-07-01

We will countersign the sponsorship agreement and upload to the Drive link you provided by Monday. Please go ahead and provision the credits to accounts@openedu.org when you have the signed agreement.

Best,
Leena
